response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_code, s.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.riskeval), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, 1.0 * scan_count / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS scan_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scan_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM grouped) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, average_compression_ratio, scan_count, scan_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY scan_share DESC, site_code, risk_evaluation_status;
